title: Make Your Game
goal: Design YOUR dream game. Bytey will help you think it through.
mascot_lines: Last lesson — and the BEST one!
Tell me about your DREAM game.
I will ask you about the world, the hero, and the special move.
We will save your design doc when you are done!

tier2.rephrase: What kind of game would YOU love to play? Type it and Bytey will help.

tier3.nudge: Stuck? Try: 'A game where you ___ and the bad guys ___'.

payload.prompt: Tell Bytey about your dream game!
questions: Who is the hero, and what can they do?
What does the world look like?
What is the special move only YOUR hero has?
What is the very last level like?
